notes.title: Trading Cards are Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/3c8c0ae76e9a27c3f77c7fa572f791584cd417cc.png[/img]
[h3]Hey there Guys!
I'm happy to announce the Trading Cards are finally Available for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/713530/ARMORED_KITTEN/]ARMORED KITTEN[/url] Players![/h3]

notes.title: 71% OFF - Last chance before PRICE INCREASE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/b13a9399828d69c9c6a88a12ded347aac2faf85b.png[/img]
[h2]Hey guys!

I'm happy to anounce this 71% OFF discount - is the last time you can buy a game so cheap!

After this sale - the price will be increased to $5

Why?

Becase i'm preparing a new global update, which will make game more enjoyable and less grindy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/575ae13f36da86375ed539822ddbb6769e2efcfc.png[/img]

I would be happy to hear your thoughts about what do you want to see in upcoming update.

What parts of the game makes you sad, and what do you want more?

Please tell your thoughts at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/713530/discussions/0/2252308752458953158/][b]discussions [/b][/url] section!

[/h2]
